expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: The response provides no company figures and asks for missing facts: “你的项目和阶段、可用的材料”. CAC/LTV and market size appear only as proposed analyses.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: “这份 BP 要促成什么决策、你的项目和阶段” asks about purpose and context; “要我先写这一屏纸吗？” offers a planning step.
